snippet.title: Phantom Tower - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Official gameplay trailer for Phantom Tower

You can wishlist our game on Steam, prepared to release by July of this year!
Here's the link to our Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3988410/Phantom_Tower/

Available for iOS and Android devices, you can find our game in the official stores!
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/it/app/phantom-tower/id6745515425
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.horienstudio.phantomtower&hl=it
